card.name: Monitoring and reassessment wording in labels
card.fires_on: Words that introduce checking or monitoring, such as 'ically' in 'Periodically' and 'clinical' before monitoring, laboratories or examination, in label instructions.

modes.label: Periodically reassess
modes.description: The ending of 'Periodically' at the start of an instruction to reassess treatment.
modes.example: Period<<ically>> reassess the need for continued treatment.

modes.label: Clinical before monitoring
modes.description: The word 'clinical' placed before monitoring, examination or laboratories.
modes.example: Perform routine<< clinical>> examination, including assessment of development, mental

modes.label: Other monitoring or schedule words
modes.description: A word inside an instruction to monitor levels or to repeat something at intervals.
modes.example: Serum potassium levels should be monitored and<< deficiencies>> corrected.

card.plain: It lights up on words that set up an instruction to check, monitor or reassess a patient.
